inherited_thermal_assumptions.U_status: 0.7 retained predecessor; 1.5 planning target; 2.5 degraded-envelope sensitivity. None is demonstrated whole-body U.
inherited_thermal_assumptions.weather_and_ventilation_status: Retained engineering sensitivities, not official climate design data or adopted ventilation rate; solar separated from evening duty.
inherited_thermal_assumptions.duct_status: Geometric gross duct allocation; insulation/liners/grilles and pressure loss reduce usable area. Not an airflow acceptance.
inherited_thermal_assumptions.occupancy_status: Regular: 32 passengers plus one thermal person allowance. Accessible: 13 passengers plus one thermal person allowance. Whole consist: 113 thermal occupants. These allowances are not a staffing prescription.
inherited_thermal_assumptions.internal_heat_status: The 200 W internal-equipment thermal allocation is separate from the 1080 W electrical auxiliary schedule. Reconcile actual fan, lighting and control heat entering the cabin and underfloor charger/conversion losses before selection.

heat_cases.meaning: conditional direct-light120+fresh-air-fan250+hotel-control50 into occupied cabin. Chargers/DC heat elsewhere; assumes all fan work counted here, not in selected HVAC capacity twice.
conditional all allocated AC auxiliary energy eventually becomes cabin heat. Not actual connected/running rating. Do not add downstream DC/charger power a second time.
